source: client application note — VIN code identification (Tesla example)

title.en: VIN Code Identification: A Tesla Example
title.zh: 汽车 VIN 码识别 —— 以特斯拉为例

subtitle.en: Multiple VIN points across the vehicle — laser marking and high-performance labels, chosen by application.
subtitle.zh: 全车多点 VIN 标识 —— 按场景选择激光刻印与高性能标签。

seo_desc.en: How modern vehicles like Tesla identify the VIN across windshield, door jamb, structural body and battery packs — combining permanent laser marking with durable industrial labels for lifecycle traceability and anti-counterfeiting.
seo_desc.zh: 现代汽车（如特斯拉）如何在挡风玻璃、门框、车身结构件与电池包上标识 VIN——结合永久激光刻印与耐久工业标签，实现全生命周期追溯与防伪。

zh.label: 应用范围
zh.value: 挡风玻璃、门框、车身结构件、电池包

zh.label: 应用产品
zh.value: 激光刻印 + 高性能工业标签

en.label: Scope
en.value: Windshield, door jamb, structural body, battery packs

intro.zh: VIN 需在整车整个使用寿命内保持清晰可读、可追溯。车辆不同部位所处环境各异，单一标识方式难以适配所有场景，制造商必须在耐久性、法规合规、可维护性与防篡改之间取得平衡。
intro.en: A VIN must stay readable and traceable for the vehicle's whole service life. Different locations face different environments, so no single method fits everywhere — manufacturers must balance durability, regulatory compliance, serviceability and tamper resistance.

intro.zh: 特斯拉在全车采用多种 VIN 标识方式，每种技术均按应用场景选择：
intro.en: Tesla identifies the VIN at several points across the vehicle, each with the technology that best fits the application:

zh.label: 挡风玻璃激光 VIN
zh.text: 挡风玻璃下方激光刻印 VIN，便于快速目视检查。

zh.label: 门框认证标签
zh.text: 门框处认证标签承载所需的法规与合规信息。

zh.label: 结构件隐藏 VIN
zh.text: 在车身结构件上永久刻印隐藏 VIN，有效防止篡改。

zh.label: 电池包追溯标签
zh.text: 电池包与驱动单元采用耐久标签，支持质保与全生命周期追溯。

en.label: Windshield laser VIN
en.text: A laser-marked VIN beneath the windshield enables quick visual inspection.

en.label: Door-jamb certification label
en.text: A certification label on the door jamb carries the required regulatory and compliance information.

en.label: Structural hidden VIN
en.text: Hidden VIN markings are permanently engraved on structural body components to prevent tampering.

en.label: Battery-pack traceability labels
en.text: Battery packs and drive units carry durable labels for warranty and lifecycle traceability.

zh: 增强全生命周期防伪能力。
en: Strengthens anti-counterfeiting across the vehicle lifecycle.
